from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import Literal

class RegionDataPoint(BaseModel):
    """One data point (month, region, value) extracted from a specific housing report."""
    source_report_date: str | None = Field(description="Date of the release document, for precedence resolution")
    data_month: str | None = Field(description="The month the data represents (YYYY-MM)")
    region: Literal["Northeast", "Midwest"] = Field(description="The specific region covered by this data")
    units_not_seasonally_adjusted: float | None = Field(description="Housing starts count (in thousands), not seasonally adjusted")
    flag: str | None = Field(description="Preliminary (p) or Revised (r) marker")
    quote: str = Field(description="Excerpt from the report source text")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    region_data_points: list[RegionDataPoint]
